label: Netgear M4250-8G2XF-PoE+ (GSM4210PX)
description: Netgear AV Line desktop switch: 8x 1G PoE+ (220 W) + 2x 1G/10G SFP+, 1G out-of-band management port, USB-C console. 56 Gbps fabric, external 254 W power adapter, 210 x 140 x 40 mm.

fabric.note: Vendor 56 Gbps non-blocking fabric across 10 ports (8 x 1G + 2 x 10G = 28 Gbit/s each way); forwarding rate 41.67 Mpps, line rate.

poe.note: 220 W across the 8 PoE+ ports, i.e. 27.5 W per port available on average against an 802.3at port ceiling of 30 W. The same eight-port copper block as the M4250-9G1F-PoE+ sits behind a 254 W adapter rather than a 130 W one.

notes: M4250 series common platform: 16K MAC addresses, 4K ARP/NDP entries, 4K VLANs, static routes (894 IPv4 / 126 IPv6) plus RIP (32 IPv4), DHCP server (2K leases), sFlow, SNMP, console/telnet/SSH CLI and the AV web GUI. Desktop chassis, external 254 W adapter, selectable fan modes (fanless / quiet 19.3 dBA / cool) rather than truly fanless. No non-PoE copper ports: all eight copper ports are PSE ports. Console is USB-C only. The two cages are 1G/10G SFP+, which is what separates this model from the M4250-9G1F-PoE+ (nine copper ports and one 1G SFP). Sources: datasheet https://www.downloads.netgear.com/files/GDC/M4250/M4250_Datasheet.pdf and https://kb.netgear.com/000064904/NETGEAR-AV-Line-of-Fully-Managed-Switches-M4250-Series.
